title: 葵ステークスの後に・バクシン、極

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She finishes the race at an exceptional speed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Believing her speed has yet to peak, I propose running in the Sprinters Stakes, the pinnacle of short-distance races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O decides to challenge the Sprinters Stakes, her eyes set on becoming the fastest!
